p.i: dium. num. 33. Schrader. de feud. Part. 9. cap. 4 n. 61. Befold. ad l. 3. D. just. & jur. n. 10.

main_text.p: Unde multo magis apparitori impunè resisti potest, si nullo superioris mandato intercedente, quem prehendere, vel quid executioni mandare velit. l. 5. Cod. de Sport. & sumpt. Faber in Cod. defin. 1. tit. Quando lic. unic. fin. jud. Amaya ad l. 5. Cod. de jur. fisc. num. 10. Diff. Pinzing. quaest. Saxon 54. vid. Menoch. ibidemque varios allegatos de Recup. Possess. remed. 1. num. 311.

Verùm, quod tertium erat l. propositæ contentum, quæs. quibus positis circumstantiis ea permissa defensio? Resp. Si adsit moderamen: quod secundùm DD. in tribus consistit. Modo, tempore & causâ. Modo, si necessaria defensio, si præ-

page.notes: Printed "præ-" at the foot is a catchword, and "Q" is the gathering signature. The line "Verùm, quod tertium erat l.propositæ" may read "1." rather than "l.", which I have kept as printed. The italic and roman boundaries in the citation paragraph are approximate. The long s in "quaef." and "defenfio" is printed as f and rendered here as s.
